saveRefused: Couldn't save that change. Showing the saved version.
sectionNotEmpty: This section still has notes under it. Delete them first, then the heading.
insertAppended: A new line could not go where you put it, so it was saved at the end of the note.
insertNotSaved: A new line could not be saved. It stays here, marked Not saved; edit it to try again.
draftsKept: New lines that could not be saved stay here, marked Not saved.

ref.anchorLost: Anchor lost: not found after the paper was re-ingested. Your quote is kept.
ref.latexByModel: LaTeX transcribed by the model · check it against the page
ref.ocrText: OCR text · check numbers against the crop
ref.layerText: Text under the box, from the page's text layer

slash.calloutHint: A tinted box that stands out
slash.quotePaperHint: Select text in the reader; it lands here.

draft.hint: Kept on this screen only. Edit it to try again.
